paras: Cyrtodactylus feae  is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is native to Southeast Asia.
The specific name, feae, is in honor of Leonardo Fea, who was an Italian explorer and naturalist.
C. feae is found in Myanmar and Thailand.
The preferred natural habitat of C. feae is forest.
The holotype of C. feae, which may be a juvenile, has a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of only 4.6 cm (1.8 in).
